gloss: Minister for Foreign Affairs; foreign minister

definitions.gloss: Minister for Foreign Affairs; foreign minister
definitions.explanation: The cabinet minister in charge of foreign relations, head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs ({外務省|がいむしょう}). Often shortened to {外相|がいしょう} in the news.

examples.japanese: {外務大臣|がいむだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The foreign minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {外務大臣|がいむだいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}する→訪問する：26836_houmonsuru⟧。
examples.english: The foreign minister will visit the United States next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外務大臣|がいむだいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧し、{経済協力|けいざいきょうりょく}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: The foreign ministers of the two countries met and discussed economic cooperation.

notes:
⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧ (foreign affairs) + ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧ (minister).

- ⟦{外相|がいしょう}→外相：28165_gaishou⟧: short form used in headlines and news
